sn22.36:1.2: Atha kho aññataro bhikkhu yena bhagavā…pe… ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
sn22.36:1.3: ‘‘sādhu me, bhante, bhagavā saṃkhittena dhammaṃ desetu yamahaṃ bhagavato dhammaṃ sutvā eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto vihareyya’’nti.
sn22.36:1.7: yaṃ nānumīyati na tena saṅkhaṃ gacchatī’’ti.
sn22.36:2.1: ‘‘Yathā kathaṃ pana tvaṃ, bhikkhu, mayā saṃkhittena bhāsitassa vitthārena atthaṃ ājānāsī’’ti?
sn22.36:2.9: Rūpaṃ ce, bhante, nānuseti na taṃ anumīyati;
sn22.36:2.10: yaṃ nānumīyati na tena saṅkhaṃ gacchati.
sn22.36:2.14: viññāṇaṃ ce nānuseti na taṃ anumīyati;
sn22.36:2.15: yaṃ nānumīyati na tena saṅkhaṃ gacchati.
sn22.36:2.16: Imassa khvāhaṃ, bhante, bhagavatā saṃkhittena bhāsitassa evaṃ vitthārena atthaṃ ājānāmī’’ti.
sn22.36:3.2: Sādhu kho tvaṃ, bhikkhu, mayā saṃkhittena bhāsitassa vitthārena atthaṃ ājānāsi.
sn22.36:3.3: Rūpaṃ ce, bhikkhu, anuseti taṃ anumīyati;
sn22.36:3.8: viññāṇaṃ ce, bhikkhu, anuseti taṃ anumīyati;
sn22.36:3.10: Rūpaṃ ce, bhikkhu, nānuseti na taṃ anumīyati;
sn22.36:3.11: yaṃ nānumīyati na tena saṅkhaṃ gacchati.
sn22.36:3.15: viññāṇaṃ ce nānuseti na taṃ anumīyati;
sn22.36:3.16: yaṃ nānumīyati na tena saṅkhaṃ gacchati.
sn22.36:3.17: Imassa kho, bhikkhu, mayā saṃkhittena bhāsitassa evaṃ vitthārena attho daṭṭhabbo’’ti…pe…
sn22.36:3.18: aññataro ca pana so bhikkhu arahataṃ ahosīti.
